title: TRAUMA-INFORMED CARE IN EDUCATION II
description: Delves into practical applications of trauma-informed care including examining proactive behavior management plan models, de-escalation strategies, and resiliency-based practices for use with students in grades K-12 and beyond.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: ED 225.
A minimum grade of C is required in ED 225.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
clssnotes:
Hybrid section; both on-site meetings and online component.
